FACULTY SENATE OFFICE 224 P ASTORE H ALL , 51 L OWER C OLLEGE R OAD , K INGSTON , R I 02881 U SA , P: 401.874.2616 Faculty Senate Resolution 2025-2026-01 Resolution of Appreciation and Gratitude Honoring Kent and Diane Fannon WHEREAS , Kent and Diane Fannon, distinguished alumni of the University of Rhode Island, Class of 1974, have made a profound and lasting impact on the University through their longtime support of the University of Rhode Island; and WHEREAS , the Fannon’s previous gifts, including direct scholarships for students, endowed support for the College of Business, and establishment of the Diane and Kent Fannon Education Research Endowment, have already made a significant impact on the University and its students; and WHEREAS , the University College for Academic Success has evolved into a dynamic center for student community and support under the visionary leadership of founding Dean Emerita Jayne Richmond and current Executive Director Kim Stack; and WHEREAS , the Fannon’s commitment to student achievement, career readiness, and holistic support have now propelled the launch of the Fannon Institute for Student Success, which will transform the University College for Academic Success with revitalized and modernized programming; and WHEREAS , the new Fannon Institute for Student Success will bring together, under one administrative umbrella, five key areas of student support: Career and Experiential Education, Academic Enhancement, Retention, Exploratory Advising, and Student-Athlete Support Services; and WHEREAS , creation of the Fannon Institute for Student Success will transform the student experience, ensuring that every student has access to the tools, mentorship, and resources to succeed; and, finally, WHEREAS , Kent and Diane Fannon’s extraordinary generosity is a testament to their unwavering belief in the power of education and their desire to leave a legacy that will inspire future generations; NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED , that the Faculty Senate of the University of Rhode Island, on behalf of the entire General Faculty, expresses its profound appreciation and heartfelt gratitude to the Fannon Family for their visionary generosity, their enduring legacy of support for URI students, and their commitment to ensuring that generations of students will have the tools and resources they need to achieve their highest ambitions; and BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED , that this resolution be entered into the official minutes of the Faculty Senate and that a copy be sent to Kent and Diane Fannon as a token of our deep appreciation.
